description: This file contains the source code for the 'Basic' controller class within the OpenCart admin theme extension namespace. It defines a class that extends the core Controller class and includes methods for rendering the theme configuration page and saving theme settings via JSON responses.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: Controller class for managing theme settings in the OpenCart admin panel extension for 'Basic' theme.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering the theme configuration page, loading language, setting the page title, breadcrumbs, theme status, and common page controllers.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the theme settings via an AJAX request, checking permissions, updating settings in the database, and returning success or error messages in JSON format.
